meta.execution: Signal at T close, execution at T+1 open; final close forced at interval end.

current_app.formula: Entry: MU SMA22 crosses SMA30; short side symmetric. Filters: QQQ SMA150 filter. Exit: qualified reverse signal; take profit 8%.
